structuralHypothesis: Bare governed tax topics extended (tax sparing, situs, TIN registration, taxpayer remedies). An unambiguous tax instrument whose name contains an ordinary verb (authority to print, books of accounts) is subject matter, not a requested action, unless an explicit non-tax object borrows the words for another domain. An ordinary imperative data-handling action governing a destination is the primary task even when its object is a tax-shaped token. Narrowed the non-tax setting test so a school is not itself a non-tax domain, and admitted taxable/vatable and receipt-issuance instruments as genuine tax anchors.
